gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-lisu-bosa: Otherworldly letters from Alien Encounters leave big gaps between pairs, while Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, keeps its counters spilling open. And that is the strongest thing here: a sci-fi display voice sitting on sturdy, tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-marcellus: Technological and strange, Alien Encounters stretches its high x-height across wide letter gaps for a futuristic look. Marcellus SC takes the opposite job, with gentle stroke modulation and pulled-back terminals that feel literary and dignified.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-noto-seri: Strange, spaced-out, and tall. Alien Encounters opens its letter pairs wide, and Noto Serif Hentaigana follows with a refined serif whose small letters nearly reach capital height. Alien Encounters is built to turn heads with low modulation, but the body font does its best work in visible, moderate thick-thin strokes.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-ovo: Ovo brings a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and thins barely lighter than its thicks. And with spacious gaps at its curve terminals, a long stretch of text moves along with soft accents of heavier strokes, while Alien Encounters stays out in front.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding up top, dignified below. Amadeus does its best work stretching words wide with pipe-like strokes, while Epunda Slab, a serif, rewards close reading with its tall rounded lowercase and visibly gaping c.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads tall in the middle band, with shallow ascenders and descenders and a generous entry into the e's eye. Amadeus is the one for wide, blunt statements; this serif is for quiet prose.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-glegoo: Glegoo, a text serif, reads with big counters in a tall lowercase and curved letters whose mouths stay wide open. Shrink Amadeus too far and its wide, unmodulated stems lose their punch.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-hanuman: Wide, bold, and unshaded, with Amadeus stretching words across the line. Hanuman, a classic serif, then carries a long passage with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s, feeling traditional and refined.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-kadwa: Kadwa, a classic serif, reads with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height. Amadeus is best at bold, hairline-free letterforms stretched wide, while Kadwa does its finest work as the editorial voice underneath.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text opens each curved letter with a big visible entrance. Its lowercase fills most of the letter height, so a long passage feels literary and dignified beneath the wide, commanding Amadeus.
